source_text.body:
Script image metadata tagging and Photoshop embedding
A commenter had Claude write scripts that scan images, write metadata, and embed it in Photoshop, building a batch web-image mockup tool.
·
Nov 9, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A commenter on a 5-person art team said they use Claude across repetitive production work: compiling their data into better sheets, pulling artwork from folders to build customer-facing catalogs, and writing metadata for artworks. They also had Claude write one script to scan images and generate metadata, then another to embed that metadata in Photoshop, which they used in a batch web-image mockup tool.
How it went
They said the mockup tool cut web-image creation time to one-tenth of the old process. More broadly, they said Claude lets their 5-person art team produce and organize like a team of 30.
Worth knowing
The main practical catch is that the post gives results and tasks, but not the scripts, workflow details, or setup steps you would need to copy it exactly.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Write me a script that scans the images in [folder path], generates a descriptive title, caption, and keywords for each one, and writes them into the file's metadata. Then add a step that [embeds or uses this metadata in Photoshop/another tool] for a batch mockup of [web page or layout]. Test it on [3] copies of my images first and show me the results. Only run it on the full folder after I approve, and never overwrite the originals.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xq8b1u/recently_got_access_to_claude_at_work_what_are
